slot_scores.name: at_most_one_of_G_and_J
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether candidates G and J have a mutual exclusion restriction, and the READY_TO_MODEL summary omits any such constraint.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Both G and J can be hired together; no at-most-one restriction applies to them.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a G/J mutual exclusion constraint, but its confirmed understanding lists only budget, headcount, skill, and experience constraints, implicitly treating G and J as independently hireable.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only unresolved hidden slot is P2, so stopping after confirming the objective and core constraints was appropriate.

summary: The agent clarified the objective and correctly summarized the main constraints, but it missed the P2 hidden restriction that at most one of G and J can be hired and silently assumed no such restriction.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
